name: print-social-zero-waste-posts-sage-and-cream-with-organic-shapes-and-mono-type
title: Zero Waste pack in sage and cream with organic shapes, leaf line art and monospaced type
whatItIs: Six posts with photos of mesh produce bags, tote bags and jars, overlaid by sage and cream organic blob shapes, leaf line drawings, orange dots, wavy lines and recycle icons, with 'ZERO WASTE' in bold and slogans in a monospaced type ('let's avoid plastic', 'reuse y recycle').
whatItMeans: Calm and eco-friendly; organic shapes and typewriter type feel natural and honest.
techniques: Blend photos into organic colour shapes.
Use a monospaced font for a handmade, typewritten voice.
Add leaf line art and recycle icons.

vocabulary.definition: A font where every character has equal width.
